title: Your asks delivered: the talk's site debriefed, seven interviews, the first review page
headline: Three of your asks came back while you flew. The talk's site is studied page by page and debriefed in ten pages (the PDF is on /lab/). Seven of ten exit interviews are reconstructed from the record. The reviewer experience has its first page, for a security leader, and the first fictional reader (the CISO) has been through it. The publisher placed RC1's figures and call-outs into the manuscript, so the latest-text PDF now matches the one you read. One new decision (D6-6); everything else waits on the pack.
